newsitem.title: USA: Medical Industries in pact with two firms.
newsitem.headline: Medical Industries in pact with two firms.

text.p: Medical Industries of America Inc said Tuesday it formed an alliance with Vitacare Inc and Damadian MRI to develop and jointly operate two medical diagnostic centers in central Florida.
It said the first center, to be located in south Orlando, is expected to be fully operational by September 1 and will service primarily the 282 physician members associated with Vitacare.
The second center, to be located in North Orlando, is scheduled to be fully operational by March 31, 1998, it said.
Medical Industries, which provides diagnostic and therapeutic healthware services to the medical community, said that projected annual revenues from each facility are expected to exceed $2.4 million.
